cardOverview.overviewText: A flagship premium lifestyle card offering global lounge access, concierge services, milestone vouchers, and high reward rates on travel and dining.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

eligibility:
Spend ₹1 Lakh or more in a calendar quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec).
On meeting the spend criteria, visit the Regalia SmartBuy page >> Lounge Benefits >> Lounge access voucher.
You can avail up to 2 complimentary lounge access vouchers as part of the quarterly milestone benefit.
Lounge Access can be availed via priority pass which can be issued on request for both Primary Cardholder and Add-on cardholder after making a minimum of 4 transactions from a card.
